en.headline: Hang Seng slips below 24,000 at the Thursday midday close
en.dek: The index was down 167 points at 23,963 by midday, according to RTHK, with turnover above 100 billion dollars.
body: The Hang Seng Index fell below 24,000 at Thursday's midday close. Radio Television Hong Kong reported the index at 23,963, down 167 points, or about 0.7 per cent. Market data carried by the Hong Kong Economic Journal showed the same level, 23,963.31, a fall of 167.19 points.

RTHK said turnover by midday had risen above 100 billion dollars. The index had opened lower in the morning, with early reports putting the opening drop at about 98 points, before the loss widened into the lunch break.

Technology shares were broadly weaker in the morning session, according to market reports, while coal and oil names were among the firmer sectors. The China Enterprises Index was also lower, with the Economic Journal showing it down about 22 points at midday.
Wednesday's close was 24,130.50. A full-day result will not be known until the afternoon session ends.

zh.headline: 恒指半日失守24000點 跌167點
zh.dek: 港台報道，恒指午市報23963點，跌167點，跌幅約百分之0.7，半日成交逾1000億元。
body: 恒生指數周四午市收市失守24000點。港台報道，指數報23963點，跌167點，跌幅約百分之0.7。信報行情顯示同一水平為23963.31點，跌167.19點。
港台指半日成交已增至逾1000億元。大市早段低開，有報道指開市跌約98點，跌幅至午市擴大。
市場報道指，科網股早段普遍偏弱，煤炭及石油股則較為穩健。國企指數亦向下，信報午市行情顯示跌約22點。
周三收市報24130.50點。全日走勢要待下午市完結才有定論。
